title: Rebuild incomplete generated pack to satisfy full v3.1 output contract
scope: All generated 6LAYER control, specification, graph, execution, verification, and casebook files
blocker: The current transcript and materialized target pass the provided shape validator, but multiple required files are compressed summaries rather than complete v3.1 content. EP plans lack the required 14 sections and milestone grammar; HARNESS_LAWS lacks the instantiated harness law body; casebooks use generic commands/oracles rather than complete project-specific execution contracts.
required_direction: Reconstruct the complete pack from the full master prompt, preserving all required file bodies, exact command bindings, project-specific vocabulary, 484 registry rows, 42 DOD clauses, canonical source archive, 20 E2E suites, 15 supplemental gates, complete casebooks, and all v3.1 anti-gaming controls. Upgrade validation so these omissions cannot pass.
unblock_condition: Codex produces a complete contract-compliant pack, runs the strengthened validator and anti-gaming classification, and records evidence tied to the final transcript and materialized files.
release_impact: Blueprint pack is not accepted as complete; application construction remains forbidden; no production deployment is permitted.
